summary: GM Financial Automobile Leasing Trust 2026-3 filed an 8-K to report entry into a material definitive agreement for a securitization issuance. The issuing entity will issue multiple classes of asset-backed notes totaling approximately $1.0 billion, backed by auto lease assets. This is a routine structured finance transaction, not a special situation. The filing satisfies an undertaking to file agreements for the registered notes. No special-situation elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, or restructurings are present.
